notes: Fixes the blank-screen startup crash introduced in v0.5.2 (an undeclared ipcDead reference in the login screen threw a ReferenceError before anything could render) and implements the IPC watchdog that release described: 2-second pings to the backend; if the webview-to-Rust bridge is stuck, a red banner with a one-click Reload button appears. Also fixes 14 more same-class crashes: dashboard versement view/load-in-POS/print actions, quick-purchase error state, product webcam toggle, customer/supplier pinning, notification deep-links.
